patch_description: Replace the underperforming hypercube’s medium-range links with staggered nearest-neighbor CZ links, restoring full ring communication while retaining parameter-free entanglement and the same gate count. Then use one globally shared angle across alternating RY/RX axes. This reduces the distinct parameter count from two to one while preserving parity-sensitive transformations through noncommuting rotation axes, matching the strongest structural traits seen in prior feedback.
